mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderation_decisions (id, content_type, content_id, field_label, user_id, visibility, layer, decision, category, matched_term_id, matched_text, policy_version, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{fieldLabel}, #{userId}, #{visibility}, #{layer}, #{decision}, #{category}, #{matchedTermId}, #{matchedText}, #{policyVersion}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO image_moderation_results (id, object_key, checksum, user_id, entry_point, decision, category, confidence, provider, raw_scores, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{objectKey}, #{checksum}, #{userId}, #{entryPoint}, #{decision}, #{category}, #{confidence}, #{provider}, #{rawScores}::jsonb, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT decision, layer, COUNT(*) AS total FROM moderation_decisions WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY decision, layer ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}) AS raised, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pending, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'KEPT' AND reviewed_at >= #{from}) AS kept, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'REMOVED' AND reviewed_at >= #{from}) AS removed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ESCALATED') AS escalated, COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (reviewed_at - created_at))) FILTER (WHERE reviewed_at >= #{from}), 0) AS average_handling_seconds FROM moderation_flags

SELECT t.id AS term_id, t.term, t.category, t.action, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.status = 'KEPT') AS kept_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.status = 'REMOVED') AS removed_count, COUNT(d.id) AS decision_count FROM moderation_decisions d JOIN moderation_terms t ON t.id = d.matched_term_id LEFT JOIN moderation_flags f ON f.content_type = d.content_type AND f.content_id = d.content_id AND f.category = d.category WHERE d.created_at >= #{from} AND d.matched_term_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.id, t.term, t.category, t.action ORDER BY kept_count DESC, decision_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS reported, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM moderation_flags f WHERE f.content_type = r.content_type AND f.content_id = r.content_id AND f.source <> 'USER_REPORT' ) ) AS missed_by_filter FROM content_reports r WHERE r.created_at >= #{from}

SELECT category, decision, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(AVG(confidence), 0) AS average_confidence FROM image_moderation_results WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, decision ORDER BY total DESC
